purpose: Verify the trigger manual backup use case.
preconditions: An authenticated actor with backup-manage permission and a configured backup target.
action_or_input: Submit a valid manual-backup request to POST /api/v1/badms/backups/manual/.
expected_result: A point-in-time backup operation is created and a BackupRecord is returned with HTTP 201.

purpose: Verify the submit secure archival request use case.
preconditions: An authenticated user has data eligible for archival and the required metadata is available.
action_or_input: Submit a valid archival request to POST /api/v1/badms/archival-requests/.
expected_result: The archival request is created with its submitted data and metadata and HTTP 201 is returned.

purpose: Verify the decide secure archival request use case.
preconditions: A pending archival request belongs to the HoD's own department; actor is that department's HoD.
action_or_input: Approve or reject the request through POST /api/v1/badms/archival-requests/{id}/decide/.
expected_result: The decision is recorded for the HoD's own-department request and the updated request is returned.

purpose: Verify the classify secure archival data use case.
preconditions: An archival request has been approved; actor has SysAdmin classification authority.
action_or_input: Submit an authoritative classification through POST /api/v1/badms/archival-requests/{id}/classify/.
expected_result: The request receives the authoritative classification used to determine security and retention treatment.

purpose: Verify the configure sensitive-data encryption use case.
preconditions: An approved archival request is classified Sensitive; actor has IT Security authority.
action_or_input: Configure encryption through POST /api/v1/badms/archival-requests/{id}/configure-encryption/.
expected_result: Required encryption is configured and an encrypted archive is created for the Sensitive data.

purpose: Verify the execute scheduled automatic backup use case.
preconditions: An effective backup schedule is due and the backup task infrastructure is available.
action_or_input: Run evaluate_and_dispatch_due_backups for the due schedule.
expected_result: The backup defined by the effective schedule is executed without user intervention.

purpose: Verify the submit storage-extension request use case.
preconditions: The user's storage quota is full and the user is authenticated.
action_or_input: Submit a valid request to POST /api/v1/badms/storage-extensions/.
expected_result: A storage-extension request is submitted for additional storage.

purpose: Verify the decide storage-extension request use case.
preconditions: A pending storage-extension request belongs to the HoD's own department; actor is that department's HoD.
action_or_input: Approve or reject the request through POST /api/v1/badms/storage-extensions/{id}/decide/.
expected_result: The HoD's decision is recorded for the request in their own department.

purpose: Verify the configure local backup schedule use case.
preconditions: Actor has SysAdmin authority and a dataset is available for scheduling.
action_or_input: Create or update a dataset-specific local schedule through the local schedule API.
expected_result: The local automated backup schedule is created or updated for the specified dataset.

purpose: Verify the perform special archival operation use case.
preconditions: An offline request from an authority has been received; actor is Super Admin; Sensitive research data requires extended storage.
action_or_input: Submit the special archival operation to POST /api/v1/badms/archival-requests/special/.
expected_result: The special archival operation for the Sensitive research data is performed and recorded.

purpose: Verify the define global backup schedules and defaults use case.
preconditions: Actor is Super Admin and institution-wide backup policy settings are available.
action_or_input: Create or update global schedules/defaults through the global schedule API.
expected_result: Institution-wide global backup schedules and default backup policies are set.

purpose: Verify the view audit logs and activity history use case.
preconditions: Actor is SysAdmin and audit records exist.
action_or_input: Request GET /api/v1/badms/audit-logs/.
expected_result: Operational audit logs and activity histories are returned for review.

purpose: Verify the audit data activity and review security reports use case.
preconditions: Actor is IT Security and security-related activity records exist.
action_or_input: Request GET /api/v1/badms/audit-logs/security/.
expected_result: Security activity records and security-related reports are returned for inspection.

purpose: Verify the view backup history and status use case.
preconditions: Actor is authenticated and backup operations exist within the actor's visibility scope.
action_or_input: Request GET /api/v1/badms/backups/.
expected_result: The actor receives current backup status and history limited to records visible to them.

purpose: Verify the track request status use case.
preconditions: Actor is authenticated and archival requests exist within the actor's visibility scope.
action_or_input: Request GET /api/v1/badms/archival-requests/.
expected_result: The actor receives the status and history of archival requests within their permitted scope.

purpose: Verify the request data restoration use case.
preconditions: Archived data is available and actor is permitted to request its restoration.
action_or_input: Submit a restoration request to POST /api/v1/badms/restorations/.
expected_result: A data-restoration request is created for the archived data.

purpose: Verify the approve sensitive data restoration use case.
preconditions: A pending restoration request concerns data classified Sensitive; actor is SysAdmin.
action_or_input: Approve or reject the request through POST /api/v1/badms/restorations/{id}/approve/.
expected_result: The Sensitive-data restoration approval decision is recorded.

purpose: Verify the execute data restoration use case.
preconditions: All required approvals and standard checks for a restoration request are satisfied; actor is SysAdmin.
action_or_input: Execute the restoration through POST /api/v1/badms/restorations/{id}/execute/.
expected_result: The archived data is technically restored after the required approvals and checks.

purpose: Verify the manage rbac permissions use case.
preconditions: Central IAM administration is available; actor is authorized in the Fusion_System_Administrator console.
action_or_input: Manage user role-based permissions through the central IAM Administration Console.
expected_result: Permissions are managed centrally; BADMS relies on its published permissions manifest and does not create local RBAC tables.

purpose: Verify the define and enforce security policies use case.
preconditions: Actor is IT Security and institution security policy settings are available.
action_or_input: Create or update security policies through POST/PUT /api/v1/badms/security-policies/.
expected_result: Institution security policies governing encryption, access, and related controls are configured and enforced.

purpose: Verify the view department data-management reports use case.
preconditions: Actor is HoD and department report data exists for the actor's own department.
action_or_input: Request GET /api/v1/badms/reports/department/.
expected_result: Department operational reports are returned scoped to the HoD's own department.

purpose: Verify the monitor storage thresholds use case.
preconditions: Authoritative user quota balances exist and the storage-monitoring task is available.
action_or_input: Run monitor_storage_thresholds against the authoritative quota balances.
expected_result: Storage usage is checked against applicable thresholds and the threshold/full-quota condition is maintained.

purpose: Verify the record audit event use case.
preconditions: An auditable user, administrative, system, or security event occurs.
action_or_input: Invoke services/audit.py::record_audit_event with the event details.
expected_result: A structured AuditEvent record is persisted for the auditable event.
